Amazon’s $130 price drop on 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 is back (All colors)

Alongside the best price ever on AirPods Pro 3, this week ushered in a series of notable Apple Watch deals, including the return of all-time low pricing across the most popular Series 11 models and some solid discounts on the even more affordable current-generation SE 3. But it is that 46mm GPS + Cell model that is delivering the most impressive discount of them all at $130 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model down at $399 shipped.

This is a regularly $529, you’re looking at a deep $130 price drop on all four case colors of this model to match the best price we have tracked to date.

While the base and more affordable GPS only models are $100 off starting from $299, this always-connected variant is seeing an even deeper discount once again. We have previously, and are right now, tracking as much as $160 off the pricey Titanium models, but catching anything better than $100 off on the more accessible variants is particularly notable.

Now even lower: Amazon offering iPhone 17 Pro at up to $270 off today (Renewed ‘excellent’)

Alongside the new all-time low live on AirPods Pro 3 this week, we are starting to track some Amazon renewed iPhone 17 Pro units with notable discounts this week, and a couple of the Cosmic Orange configurations have now dropped even lower with at up to $270 off the new list prices.

As we have detailed previously, and as you perhaps already know, finding discounts on brand new condition current-generation iPhone models is tough. These Amazon renewed units tend to be the next best thing, delivering a solid opportunity to save hundreds over buying an unlocked device straight from Apple.

A couple of the Cosmic Orange models have now dropped even lower than our recent mention with at as much as $270 under the price of buying a brand new one. Here are the best options right now:

You will find the entry current-gen MacBook Pro models starting at $1,550 on Amazon right now, but there is a very good chance some, if not all, of these machines drop even lower in the coming week or two. Score Dad a current-gen iPad for Father’s Day from $299 at Amazon

There are some big-time Apple deals up for grabs this week ahead of Father’s Day, perhaps the most notable of which is AirPods Pro 3 hitting the best price ever at nearly 30% off. But if you’re looking to land pops a new iPad this year without spending a fortune, you can score a current-generation Apple tablet as low as $299 right now.

Amazon is offering Apple’s latest 11-inch iPad (A16) starting from $299 shipped. Some colors are selling for $1 more, but we are talking about deals right at the lowest we have tracked in 2026 here.

  • iPad 11 128GB $299 (Reg. $349)
  • iPad 11 256GB $399 (Reg. $449)
  • iPad 11 256GB $597 (Reg. $649)

Regularly $349, we are yet to see the latest iPad 11 sell for any less than $299 at Amazon this year, but we rarely see it down any lower than this anyway. And even when we do, it’s typically not much more than $20 or $25 less at the most.

The iPad 11 certainly isn’t the most high-tech option in the lineup, and far from the most powerful, but if Dad just needs a handy casual tablet this is a solid price drop on a current-gen Apple iPad, and a particularly sweet gift if you ask me.

Just keep in mind, you can also land Dad the latest AirPods Pro for even less than this and they just dropped to the lowest price to date. But you’ll also want to run through our 2026 feature to get some additional gift ideas if you don’t think the Apple gear will do the trick – the options start from just $26.
